page.layout: One page of text, centred title page with an engraving in the middle; no margins with text. Blocks in reading order: top title block, coat of arms engraving, imprint block, date line. A digitiser's watermark at bottom right is left out.
page.notes: Title page. The printed date reads "ANNO cIↄ Iↄ c XLV" in the old reversed-C form, rendered here as MDCXLV. Below the title, a woodcut coat of arms with two lions supporting a shield with three lions and a crown; no text in it. Red and black type used throughout; red lines are not marked separately. The printed line "ANNO CIↃ. IↃC. XLV." reads as printed in the scan.
